object of worship, formed from clay
one who obtains the fruit previously described

items.question: What attainment results from worshipping an earthen liṅga?
premises: A person may worship an earthen liṅga.
The worship is performed as previously described.
The previously described practice yields a stated fruit.
items.inference: Therefore the worshipper becomes a sharer in the stated fruit.
items.plain_english: By worshipping an earthen liṅga, one becomes a sharer in the fruit as stated.
